# app-governance-kit

Governance skills. Each folder under `skills/` holds a SKILL.md and its reference files.

- `skills/access-review/SKILL.md` — Access review pack: Review application user and role exports against HR records, find orphaned, excessive, and privileged access, and produce an evidence summary and auditor-ready memo mapped to ISO/IEC 27001 and COBIT DSS05. Use for quarterly or annual access reviews.
- `skills/ai-intake/SKILL.md` — AI system intake and risk tiering: Take a description of an AI use case, assign a risk tier under the EU AI Act with NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001 controls, and produce an AI inventory record. Use whenever a team proposes a new AI tool or changes how one is used.
- `skills/app-governance/SKILL.md` — Application governance router: Pick the right governance skill for a plain request about a software estate, AI systems, access, or devices, ask for the data, run that skill, and hand every decision back to a person. Use when someone has a governance question but has not chosen a tool.
- `skills/cert-prep/SKILL.md` — Certification study coach: Coach a learner preparing for CAMP, CSAM, CHAMP, AIGP, ITIL 4 Foundation, or the IAM Certificate with scenario drills on the Halden demo estate, then log gaps and plan the next drills. Use for weekly study sessions or a readiness check. Not exam content and not a pass guarantee.
- `skills/crosswalk/SKILL.md` — Governance framework crosswalk: Map a control, requirement, or policy statement to ISO/IEC 19770-1, COBIT 2019, ISO/IEC 27001, and ISO/IEC 42001 clauses, and show where coverage is missing. Use when writing or auditing a control, or explaining how frameworks overlap.
- `skills/hardware-lifecycle/SKILL.md` — Hardware lifecycle check: Check a device fleet for hardware overdue for refresh and retired devices missing a confirmed data wipe, estimate replacement cost, and produce a disposal-readiness summary. Use for a refresh cycle review, before a hardware budget request, or before closing out a disposal.
- `skills/itam-maturity/SKILL.md` — ITAM maturity check: Score an organization's IT asset management maturity across nine process areas, name the three biggest gaps, and produce a 90-day plan tied to ISO/IEC 19770-1 and COBIT BAI09. Use for a baseline assessment or a yearly re-check.
- `skills/program-setup/SKILL.md` — Stand up a governance program: Design or review the launch of a governance body such as a software governance council, ITAM steering group, or AI governance board — charter, decision rights, membership, intake path, cadence, 90-day launch plan, and success measures. Use when starting a council or when an existing one has become a bottleneck or a rubber stamp.
- `skills/rationalization/SKILL.md` — Application rationalization: Recommend tolerate, invest, migrate, or eliminate for each application in an inventory, find duplicates and license problems, and summarize savings and risk. Use for portfolio reviews, budget cycles, or post-merger cleanup.
